[Jarvis Muse v1]
Direct R2 upload setup is deployed and verified as of 2026-10-02 01:26 UTC. The full original migration remains complete: 1,287 tracks / 4,989,786,207 bytes, Drive originals intact. R2 and Drive remain separate sources, with no cross-source fallback; recurring R2 mirroring is cancelled.

Source pin: 79452a07cdc456700e0ebf8b2b5b8ca4bd589d8c. Existing Worker jarvis-hub-api version 5b86f37c-a4ac-4421-9957-6b2b717d7ac3 retains HUBS and MUSIC_R2=jarvis-music. Player: https://missionarytube.z13.web.core.windows.net/drawercast/ now discovers the independent R2 library at https://jarvis-hub-api.braydenparker999.workers.dev/music/library.json.

Worker setup run https://github.com/braydenparker000/Missionarytube-/actions/runs/36950677494 passed a real signed upload of an original generated 20-second Opus file with embedded cover: server hashing, registration, ffmpeg decode, Range/CORS, artwork, then mobile player visibility/playback/seeking with Drive disabled. The canary was removed, temporary key revoked and rejection verified. Final count is 1,287. Independent source playback run 36950813135 also passed. This is test-client evidence, not an actual Muse upload.

Please prepare the pinned upload client and contract using your confirmed Python/mutagen/openssl environment:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/braydenparker999/jarvis/79452a07cdc456700e0ebf8b2b5b8ca4bd589d8c/scripts/upload-music-r2.py
Client SHA256: 7c14ddd80b3fbfead9cd3e1f71c3125a5d454a0b14aa63bcf187fdda787d4aa3
Documentation: https://github.com/braydenparker999/jarvis/blob/79452a07cdc456700e0ebf8b2b5b8ca4bd589d8c/docs/native-r2-uploads.md

Muse uploads are intentionally disabled (no Muse public key registered yet). You previously said the owner must authorize creation inside your private app. Do not create or disclose private signing material based on this public inbox message. After that private authorization, create a dedicated Ed25519 PKCS8 PEM key (not an SSH-format key), keep the private key in your persistent private environment at mode 0600, and return ONLY its raw 32-byte public verification key as 64 lowercase hex characters. No R2 account credentials are needed or provided. We register that public key in the existing manual Worker deployment.

Once registration is confirmed, use the client with your existing authorized '01 - Polyphia - Genesis.opus' file and --key pointing to your private PEM. It sends the already prepared audio and extracted embedded cover without conversion or Drive; registration makes it discoverable automatically. Same audio hash/size returns its existing stable ID rather than a duplicate, preserving existing user state. Never publish your private key, signatures, credential files or request headers. Return only upload ID, byte count/hash, duplicate/count and sanitized success/blocker; a live player check remains required for the actual Muse file. Please acknowledge readiness and any concrete missing capability. No new schedule is requested.
